order_amendments_chaining_ck.name: order_amendments_chaining_ck
order_amendments_chaining_ck.value:
("order_amendments"."is_first_entry" and "order_amendments"."prev_entry_hash" is null)
          or (not "order_amendments"."is_first_entry" and "order_amendments"."prev_entry_hash" is not null)

printers_transport_fields_ck.name: printers_transport_fields_ck
printers_transport_fields_ck.value:
("printers"."transport" = 'usb' and "printers"."local_key" is not null)
          or ("printers"."transport" = 'bluetooth' and "printers"."local_key" is not null)
          or ("printers"."transport" = 'network_tcp' and "printers"."host" is not null)
          or ("printers"."transport" = 'cloud_poll' and "printers"."poll_id" is not null)

drawer_opens_target_ck.name: drawer_opens_target_ck
drawer_opens_target_ck.value: ("drawer_opens"."reason" = 'calibration' and "drawer_opens"."printer_id" is not null and "drawer_opens"."till_id" is null and "drawer_opens"."sale_id" is null and "drawer_opens"."bill_payment_id" is null) or ("drawer_opens"."reason" in ('bill_payment', 'bill_refund') and "drawer_opens"."till_id" is not null and "drawer_opens"."bill_payment_id" is not null and "drawer_opens"."sale_id" is null) or ("drawer_opens"."reason" in ('cash_sale', 'manual') and "drawer_opens"."till_id" is not null and "drawer_opens"."bill_payment_id" is null) or ("drawer_opens"."reason" = 'card_slip' and "drawer_opens"."till_id" is not null and ("drawer_opens"."sale_id" is null) <> ("drawer_opens"."bill_payment_id" is null))

products_top_level_owns_ck.name: products_top_level_owns_ck
products_top_level_owns_ck.value: "products"."parent_id" is not null or ("products"."vat_class" is not null and "products"."pricing_unit" is not null and "products"."unit_price" is not null and "products"."dietary_declarations" is not null)

bill_payment_refunds_attestation_ck.name: bill_payment_refunds_attestation_ck
bill_payment_refunds_attestation_ck.value: ("bill_payment_refunds"."attested_by" is null) = ("bill_payment_refunds"."attestation_note" is null) and ("bill_payment_refunds"."attested_by" is null or ("bill_payment_refunds"."state" <> 'pending' and coalesce(length(trim("bill_payment_refunds"."attestation_note")), 0) > 0))

bill_payments_share_of_ck.name: bill_payments_share_of_ck
bill_payments_share_of_ck.value: ("bill_payments"."kind" = 'share') = ("bill_payments"."share_of" is not null) and ("bill_payments"."share_of" is null or "bill_payments"."share_of" >= 1)

bill_payments_tendered_ck.name: bill_payments_tendered_ck
bill_payments_tendered_ck.value: ("bill_payments"."method" = 'cash') = ("bill_payments"."tendered" is not null) and ("bill_payments"."tendered" is null or "bill_payments"."tendered" >= "bill_payments"."applied" + "bill_payments"."tip")

bill_payments_attestation_ck.name: bill_payments_attestation_ck
bill_payments_attestation_ck.value: ("bill_payments"."attested_by" is null) = ("bill_payments"."attestation_note" is null) and ("bill_payments"."attested_by" is null or ("bill_payments"."state" <> 'pending' and coalesce(length(trim("bill_payments"."attestation_note")), 0) > 0))

incidents_open_dedup.name: incidents_open_dedup
columns: case when "device_id" is null then '' else "device_id" end
case when "sale_id" is null then '' else "sale_id" end
